project_type: PHP web application (invoice management system for warehouse rentals)
build_system: None - plain PHP files uploaded to Hostinger shared hosting
test_framework: No automated test framework - manual verification via PHP syntax check
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all PHP files to verify syntax. 2. Verify directory structure is complete. 3. Verify SQL schema file exists and is valid.
setup_instructions: Upload all files in /projects/sandbox/facturas/ to the hosting root. Import database.sql into MySQL. Configure config/database.php with actual DB credentials. Install DomPDF via composer require dompdf/dompdf. Install PHPMailer via composer require phpmailer/phpmailer.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot download packages. DomPDF and PHPMailer must be stubbed with clear interfaces so user can install them on their Hostinger server. All code must be self-contained. PHP 8.4 available for syntax validation.
key_patterns: MVC-lite pattern with includes for headers/footers. Bootstrap 5 CDN for styling (will work on Hostinger with internet). PDO for database access. Session-based authentication with PIN.
directory_structure: facturas/ - root folder to upload to Hostinger. config/ - database and app configuration. includes/ - shared PHP includes (auth, header, footer, functions). admin/ - all admin panel pages (protected by session). assets/css/ - custom styles. assets/js/ - custom JavaScript. assets/img/ - logo and images. libs/ - stub files for DomPDF and PHPMailer with instructions. uploads/pdf/ - generated PDF storage. verificar/ - public invoice verification page.
